title: n8n Sustainable Use License Commercial Use: 2026 Guide
summary: n8n sustainable use license contains rules about commercial use that can affect paid products. You'll know whether your usage complies with the terms.
body_markdown:
## What licensing questions need answers


The rows above don't settle five questions. The answers come from n8n's licence text and docs as read on 26 October 2026, so recheck the current wording before you sign anything.


Using n8n for your own business is free for internal business purposes. The licence lets you use and modify n8n to run your own company's processes, including commercial ones. What it restricts is making n8n itself the thing a customer pays for.


If you are a consultant, you can charge clients to build n8n workflows. n8n's licence guidance names consulting and support services as permitted, so billing for design, build and maintenance of workflows is fine.


You cross the line when the client is effectively paying for access to n8n rather than for your work. If your invoice would read the same without n8n's name on it, you're on the safe side.


Open source it isn't. The Sustainable Use License is a source-available, "fair-code" licence, and it doesn't meet the Open Source Initiative definition because it restricts commercial use.


You can read and modify the code, but the permissions are narrower than MIT or Apache. Procurement teams that require OSI-approved licences will reject it, so say so up front.


### Do I need an enterprise licence to run n8n for several clients?


It depends on the arrangement, and the docs don't give one blanket answer. A separate instance in each client's own environment, built by you as a service, sits closer to consulting.


One instance you host and clients log into sits closer to offering n8n as a hosted service.


Separately, features in n8n's enterprise-licensed code need a paid key whoever uses them. Ask n8n sales to confirm in writing which case your setup is.


You can't resell or white-label n8n under the Sustainable Use License. Reselling, rebranding, or embedding n8n in a product you sell needs a separate commercial agreement with n8n.


Treat any plan that depends on the client never seeing n8n as a plan that needs that agreement first.
